title: SLASH · The dining room
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: Aboard, at night: the riverboat's dining room with the tables set for no one, a hostess's stand with a reservation book open, one entry, Table 14, and a coat on the back of a chair at Table 14 — green. The framer with a flashlight and the wrong shoes for a boat.

panels.composition: Full page: a riverboat's dining room at night by flashlight, tables set with glasses catching the beam, a hostess stand with an open reservation book, and at one table a chair with a green coat over its back; a man in the doorway in street shoes.

characters.pose: in the doorway with a flashlight

props: the green coat on the chair

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, a riverboat's dining room at night lit by a single flashlight beam, tables set with glasses, a hostess stand with an open book, a chair with a coat over its back at one table, a man in the doorway
image.notes: Table 14 (Vol 5: Mr. D. Dean's table). The book's one entry: letter '14' only. The coat: hers.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; rain in frantic vertical hatching; stark spotting; Arc 1's aesthetic pushed to noir
